BackstoryDef.title: colony schoolkid
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Raised on a peaceful Federation colony, they grew up with replicators, safety drills, and civic education. Science fairs and holodeck simulations were their playground.

BackstoryDef.title: starbase deck rat
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Growing up on a bustling starbase meant learning to dodge cargo drones and fix things before the quartermaster noticed. Curiosity and a toolkit went everywhere.

BackstoryDef.title: logic student
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Schooled in rigorous logic and emotional discipline. Meditation, math puzzles, and debate formed the backbone of their early years.

BackstoryDef.title: Bajoran refugee youth
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: They spent formative years displaced by conflict before the Federation offered asylum. Community aid and triage taught compassion and steady hands.

BackstoryDef.title: replicator tech’s kid
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Growing up around maintenance bays and calibration suites, they learned to coax precision out of temperamental replicators and pattern buffers.

BackstoryDef.title: settlement medic’s aide
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: On a frontier clinic, they fetched medkits and observed triage. Bedside manner and steady hands came early.

BackstoryDef.title: solar array tender
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Their chores included dusting collectors, swapping cells, and balancing microgrids during sandstorms.

BackstoryDef.title: scholarship prodigy
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: With a sponsorship to a Federation preparatory program, they devoured coursework and spent nights in simulator labs.

BackstoryDef.title: shipyard helper
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: They grew up in orbital drydocks, learning field repairs, seal checks, and how to listen for a drive core’s “hum”.

BackstoryDef.title: diplomat’s shadow
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Following a guardian through embassies and hearings, they learned protocol, patience, and how to read a room.

BackstoryDef.title: flight prep program student
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Early aptitude in simulators and orbital dynamics led them into a flight prep program with strict routines and endless practice runs.

BackstoryDef.title: junior tactical trainee
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Safety ranges, scenario drills, and de-escalation workshops built a cool head and steady aim.

BackstoryDef.title: Starfleet Academy prep candidate
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: A structured schedule of physical training, ethics seminars, and math labs prepared them for Academy entrance exams.

BackstoryDef.title: shipboard apprentice
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: Grew up helping crew with simple tasks—inventory checks, panel polishing, and learning not to press the red button.
